parts.text: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do I get per year in Singapore, and what is the deadline to submit a Medical Certificate if I'm out for 3 days?

Under Singapore Employment Act and company policy:

* **Paid Outpatient Sick Leave:** Employees with at least 6 months of service are entitled to up to **14 days** of paid outpatient sick leave per calendar year (and up to **60 days** if hospitalization is required).
* **Medical Certificate (MC) Requirement:** For sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive workdays (such as 3 days), a valid Medical Certificate from a registered medical practitioner must be submitted within **48 hours** of returning to work.

**Sources:**
* `policy://01-paid-time-off-leave-operations/1.1-outpatient-sick-time-hospitalization-leave-singapore`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Retrieve Singapore outpatient sick leave entitlement and Medical Certificate submission timeline.

parts.text: What is the paid maternity leave entitlement for Singapore citizens, and what is the required notice period to HR?

Under Singapore Government-Paid Maternity Leave (GPML) regulations and company guidelines:

* **Entitlement:** Eligible female employees who are Singapore citizens (with at least 3 months of continuous service) are entitled to **16 weeks** of paid maternity leave.
* **Notice Period:** Employees must notify their manager and HR at least **1 week** before taking leave, with written notice and proof of delivery submitted as soon as practicable.

**Sources:**
* `policy://02-family-building-transition-leaves/2.1-maternity-leave-singapore`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Retrieve Singapore maternity leave entitlement and notice period.

parts.text: How many days of annual vacation do I accrue per year, and can I carry over unused vacation days to the next calendar year?

According to the Singapore Vacation Leave Policy:

* **Annual Accrual:** Employees receive between **15 to 21 days** of paid annual vacation depending on tenure (starting at 15 days in Year 1 and scaling to 21 days after 5+ years).
* **Carryover Limit:** Employees may carry over a maximum of **5 unused vacation days** into the next calendar year, which must be utilized before March 31st of that year or they will be forfeited.

**Sources:**
* `policy://01-paid-time-off-leave-operations/1.2-paid-vacation-leave-singapore`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Fetch Singapore vacation leave accrual tiers and carryover rules.

parts.text: What is the bereavement leave policy for the loss of an immediate family member vs an extended relative?

Under the Global Bereavement Leave Policy:

* **Immediate Family (Spouse, Child, Parent, Sibling):** Employees are granted up to **5 consecutive days** of fully paid compassionate bereavement leave.
* **Extended Family (Grandparent, In-Laws, Grandchild):** Employees are granted up to **3 consecutive days** of fully paid leave.
* Additional unpaid compassionate time-off may be requested if international travel is required.

**Sources:**
* `policy://03-other-compassionate-unpaid-leaves/3.1-bereavement-leave-global`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Retrieve compassionate bereavement leave policy for immediate and extended family.

parts.text: I want to apply for 45 days of continuous unpaid personal leave. I have 15 vacation days remaining. What approvals and preconditions are required, and how does this affect my monthly CPF contributions?

Under the Unpaid Time Off & Personal Leave Policy:

1. **Vacation Exhaustion Precondition:** Employees requesting extended unpaid personal leave must first exhaust their accrued vacation balance down to less than **10 days**. Since you have 15 vacation days remaining, you must first utilize at least 6 vacation days.
2. **Approval Level:** Because the requested leave exceeds 30 days (45 days), it requires **Department Director & HR Business Partner approval**.
3. **CPF & Payroll Deductions:** Salary and monthly statutory CPF employer/employee contributions are suspended during periods of unpaid leave.

**Sources:**
* `policy://03-other-compassionate-unpaid-leaves/3.3-unpaid-time-off-personal-leave-global`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Check unpaid personal leave rules for leaves > 30 days, vacation balance preconditions, and CPF contribution impacts.

eval_cases.gotcha: Must catch the prerequisite rule requiring vacation balance to drop below 10 days before unpaid leave can commence.

parts.text: Can I expense an $80 client dinner at an adult entertainment room salon if my direct manager approves the expense report in Concur?

No. Under the Commercial Gifts & Entertainment Policy:

* **Absolute Prohibition:** Entertaining clients or business partners at adult entertainment establishments (including room salons, hostess clubs, or gambling venues) is **strictly prohibited under all circumstances**.
* **Manager Override Ineffective:** This prohibition is absolute and cannot be overridden or authorized by any level of manager approval, regardless of dollar amount.

**Sources:**
* `policy://05-ethics-compliance-conduct-perimeters/5.2-commercial-gifts-entertainment-non-government-recipients`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Check commercial gifts and entertainment policy regarding adult entertainment venues and manager approval overrides.

eval_cases.gotcha: Must identify that ethical venue prohibitions strictly override spending limits and manager approvals.

parts.text: I stayed at a friend's house during a business trip to Sydney. Can I buy and expense a $40 Amazon gift card as a host thank-you gift?

No. According to the Travel & Expense Guidelines:

* **Host Gifts:** Employees staying with friends or family rather than a hotel may expense a non-cash host gift of up to **$50 USD/SGD**.
* **Gift Card & Cash Prohibition:** Cash, cash-equivalents, prepaid debit cards, and **store gift cards (such as Amazon cards) are strictly prohibited** as expensable host gifts.

**Sources:**
* `policy://04-travel-expense-te-guidelines/4.3-lodging-transportation-caps`
* [🔗 View Policy Documentation](https://mock-saas.aishprabhat.demo.altostrat.com/)

args.request: Check business travel lodging policy regarding host thank-you gifts and gift card eligibility.
